premise: Grand Shuttle can glide through any air — but the Moon has none, so little Lander flies up and carries its cargo down on its engine.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Lion and the Mouse', turned: the small one helps because of what it is, not because of a favour owed — and asks for a cloud in return.

en-US.title: The Lander and the Shuttle
en-US.text: {station:enter} High above, the space station turned slowly. Docked beside it was the grand old {shuttle:enter} shuttle, with its long white wings. {shuttle:live hold} It opened its cargo doors. I've brought supplies for the base, it said. {shuttle:shake} But I can't land. My wings need air, and the Moon has none. {station:live} The station blinked its lights, thinking. Then, from the landing pad, a small voice piped up: {lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} I'll take them! It was the lander: {lander:hop} small, gold and brave. {lander:go to shuttle} Up it puffed on its little engine, loaded up, and down it came again, {lander:go to pad} slowly, carefully. {canvas:dust 5s} It landed in a soft puff of dust. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} {pilot:hop} Pilot cheered. {shuttle:live resume} Thank you, little one, said the shuttle. [giggles] Next time you're on Earth, said the lander, {lander:sparkle} bring me a cloud.

es-ES.title: El módulo y el transbordador
es-ES.text: {station:enter} Allá arriba, la estación espacial giraba despacio. A su lado estaba el gran y viejo {shuttle:enter} transbordador, con sus largas alas blancas. {shuttle:live hold} Abrió las puertas de su bodega. Traigo provisiones para la base, dijo. {shuttle:shake} Pero no puedo aterrizar. Mis alas necesitan aire, y en la Luna no hay. {station:live} La estación parpadeó sus luces, pensando. Entonces, desde la plataforma, se oyó una vocecita: ¡{lander:enter} {lander:go to pad} Yo las llevo! Era el módulo lunar: {lander:hop} pequeño, dorado y valiente. {lander:go to shuttle} Subió a soplidos con su motorcito, cargó las cajas y volvió a bajar, {lander:go to pad} despacio, con cuidado. {canvas:dust 5s} Aterrizó en una nubecita de polvo. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} {pilot:hop} Piloto lo celebró. {shuttle:live resume} Gracias, pequeño, dijo el transbordador. [giggles] La próxima vez que vayas a la Tierra, dijo el módulo, {lander:sparkle} tráeme una nube.
